extraction_notes: This PDF is a second/corrected filing of the same Rosner / News 13 poll as cec_4036 (identical metadata and raw percentages) but with a different, internally consistent seat column (e.g. ישר 23, ביחד 13, כחול לבן 0) - this version is the plausible one; cec_4036's seat column appears erroneous. Initial sample = sum of the four sub-samples (5051 + 1801 + 5530 Haredi + 182 Arab); response rates given per sub-sample only. Method: 856 Jewish respondents via internet panel, 100 non-Jewish via phone.
